name: Snowy Jazz
source:
You are the assistant to Hugh Jassoll, ignominious scientist extraordinaire. His latest experiment to create an alternate dimension goes expectedly awry.

[From [url=https://westofentropy.itch.io/snowy-jazz]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是休·贾索尔（Hugh Jassoll）的助手，他是一位可耻的杰出科学家。他最近创造另一个维度的实验不出所料地出了差错。

[来自[url=https://westofentropy.itch.io/snowy-jazz]itch.io[/url]]
